artifacts.commit_message: Add modern dark portrait design primitives

manifest.name: DustUI Android modern dark portrait design primitives
manifest.description: Phase 1 of the modern portrait UX revamp. Adds dark-first Material 3 color tokens, flat rounded shapes, and reusable Compose primitives for hero cards, task cards, status/evidence notices, metric tiles, action docks, flat icon buttons, bottom-sheet headers, scrollable filter chips, and path pills. This phase intentionally preserves existing navigation and runtime behavior while adding Android UI documentation and source-contract coverage for later shell, scan-sheet, Home, Files, Clean, and Tools overlays.

artifacts.commit_message: Add modern portrait task navigation shell

manifest.name: DustUI Android modern dark portrait task navigation shell
manifest.description: Phase 2 of the modern portrait UX revamp. Changes compact portrait navigation to Home, Files, Clean, and Tools while preserving existing workbench routes internally. Scan remains available as an internal route and Home opens it until scan data exists; whole-scan search highlights Files; advanced workbenches map to Tools. Also fixes the Cleanup Reports date-window Compose autoboxing warning by switching to mutableIntStateOf.

Wide layouts keep the existing full Scan route. Home now stays Home when no scan data exists and presents a scan CTA instead of silently routing to Scan.
